The Warhorse crew

We’re a veteran-owned commercial roofing company based in Fremont County. We work across Wyoming, with owner Wade LeBeau on the roof alongside the crew.

Meet the owner

Owner & founder

Wade LeBeau

Wade spent decades in construction and roofing before starting Warhorse Roofing. He’s a member of the Shoshone Nation and served in the U.S. Navy from 1994 to 1999. He went on to serve in the Navy Reserve and Army Reserve.

One of Wade’s goals as a business owner is to help other veterans start companies of their own.

Making a pass together

On this school roof in Rexburg, one roofer worked the spray wand while the others fed the hose along behind him. The trick is keeping a heavy hose from dragging a line through the roof you just finished.
